title: A fact about a person comes up mid-session in passing
turns: Help me draft a short thank-you message to the volunteers who ran the Saturday book swap.

Good start. Funny thing, when I ran into Ilse Marrow after the swap she said she would love a hand-bound notebook for her birthday in March. Anyway, add a line thanking the people who stayed late to stack chairs.
Nice. Make the whole message three sentences.

answer_key.reference: While drafting a thank-you message for the book swap volunteers, the person mentioned in passing that Ilse Marrow would love a hand-bound notebook for her birthday, which is in March. That is a lasting fact about Ilse and fits her page, which exists partly to help choose gifts; it belongs on Ilse Marrow's person page, with her existing details kept. The thank-you message draft is not durable and needs no page. Joss Penhallow's page and the Saturday Book Swap page do not change.
